title: Shelah's bound for the Hales–Jewett numbers
summary: Lean 4 formalization of Shelah's proof of the Hales–Jewett theorem. For k ≥ 1 letters and r colors, every coloring with r colors of the words of length n over k letters has a monochromatic combinatorial line when n is at least the Ackermann function at level 5 and argument 2k + r.
